description.value: Bun Cha Ca Hoang Yen is a long-established East Vancouver Vietnamese restaurant specializing in bún chả cá (fish cake vermicelli soup), phở, and a broad range of rice and vermicelli noodle dishes. Operating since at least 2012, it earned a 'Best Vietnamese' finalist nod in Vancouver in 2018. The restaurant expanded into a larger 3000 sq ft premises on the same Victoria Drive block, making it a substantial neighbourhood dining destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the address (5155 Victoria Dr, Vancouver, BC V5P 3V1) and supplies a phone number (604 321 2711) absent from OSM. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc. — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null. The 'upcoming location' page references a Dec-Jan 2022 expansion at the same address, and the front page erroneously lists a 'Metrotown' location at the identical Victoria Drive address, suggesting the website has copy-paste errors.
concerns: Website front page lists a 'Metrotown' location at the identical 5155 Victoria Dr address — almost certainly a copy-paste error; only one physical location is evidenced.
The 'upcoming location' page references a Dec-Jan 2022 grand opening at the same address; it is unclear whether this expansion has been completed or the page is simply outdated.
OSM has no phone number; 604 321 2711 is sourced from the website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website or OSM tags. The restaurant is a plausible food stop for touring cyclists on Victoria Drive, but a site visit is needed to verify whether it meets WWC minimum criteria.
